backend_api_contexts.title: Skill Codex Call API

request_schema.context: object with task-specific context for Codex
request_schema.model: optional model name, for example gpt-5

codex_permissions.internet_access: optional bool; true requires approved runtime network access

rules: For multi-item work, batch all bounded item contexts into one Codex request and require one result per item.
Do not make one sequential Codex request per item.
Leave enough of the entrypoint budget for source retrieval, parsing, cache writes, and graceful error output.

permission_rules: manifest.permissions.codex.call_response is granted by default and must remain true to call this API
manifest.permissions.network and runtime approval are required before requesting codex_permissions.internet_access=true
shell access and filesystem access through Codex are not available through this API
